filter_text: The filter: left-footed, within 5cm of 173cm, attacking midfielder or wide creator, with dribbling, creative risk-taking and transition work. Foot and height are not stylistic variance: they determine receiving angle, body mechanics, aerial duels and the 'carry through pressure' mechanism that defines this profile. Heights and feet below are to be confirmed against Transfermarkt before the report is final.
tree_note: Once the foot and height filter is applied, the lineage narrows sharply to the left-footed compact playmaker group. Players failing the filter are shown only as mechanism references.
